profile.subtitleJa: 北東アフリカの歴史的な国・地域名
profile.summaryJa: 北東アフリカの歴史的な国・地域名です。レビ記11:45では、イスラエルを「エジプトの地」から導き出した神の行為が語られます。
profile.modernLocationJa: 現代エジプトを含む北東アフリカの歴史地域。古代の範囲は時代により変わり、現在の国境と同一ではない。
profile.historicalRoleJa: イスラエルをエジプトの地から導き出したことが、レビ記11:45の命令の根拠として語られる。
profile.locationNoteJa: 候補点は地域全体の境界や出来事位置ではない。表示する場合は「地域の概略位置候補」と明記する。

primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: For I am the LORD who brought you up out of the land of Egypt, to be your God. You shall therefore be holy, for I am holy.
You shall not do as they do in the land of Egypt, where you lived. You shall not do as they do in the land of Canaan, where I am bringing you. You shall not follow their statutes.

The stranger who lives as a foreigner with you shall be to you as the native-born among you, and you shall love him as yourself; for you lived as foreigners in the land of Egypt. I am the LORD your God.
You shall have just balances, just weights, a just ephah, and a just hin. I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt.

I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, that you should not be their slaves. I have broken the bars of your yoke, and made you walk upright.
But I will for their sake remember the covenant of their ancestors, whom I brought out of the land of Egypt in the sight of the nations, that I might be their God. I am the LORD.’”
